item.title: Noble ♡ Butler
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ensemble SWEET
  • 発売日: 2025-04-25
  • スコア: 6.04/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: のーぶる♡バトラー
  • 英語名: Noble ♡ Butler

あらすじ

This here is the free nation of Liberalciora.

It’s a story about one boy and three girls, livin’ in the mansion of a certain well-off family.

Our protagonist, Fay Fleur Lenisphilia, lost his folks when he was just a kid, leaving him all alone in the world.

The ones who took him in as new family were the Lenisphilias next door. He’d known ’em since they were kids, and they grew up pretty much like siblings.

item.description:

  • 発売日: 2022-04-28
  • スコア: 7.13/10 (51 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 乙女とふれあう、ひとつ屋根の下
  • 英語名: Otome to Fureau, Hitotsu Yane no Shita

别名

  • Otofure

あらすじ

Iojaku Tsumugi, a mysterious yuri novelist known for her delicate portrayals of love between girls, has gained popularity while remaining completely absent from the media.

The truth? Iojaku Tsumugi is actually a man named Kuze Naofumi.

But even he’s hit a creative slump.

After a certain incident, he hasn’t written a word in nearly a year.

The protagonist is a student of an elite academy. He just wants to have an uneventful school life, but a call from his uncle changes everything.

His uncle is the chairman of a famous academy and is looking for a successor since he’s thinking of retiring soon. Therefore, he wants the protagonist to enroll and familiarize himself with the school.

あらすじ
